name: respeak
description: Two-lane communication for agent swarms: an efficient machine-facing shorthand lexicon for long-running sessions, plus a translator agent that renders human-facing narratives (ELI5, BLUF, technical) tuned by exposed tone and tech-level configuration.

default_mode.title: Default narrative mode
default_mode.description: Mode the translator uses when none is specified: eli5, bluf, or technical

tech_level.title: Audience technical depth
tech_level.description: 1 = no assumed background ... 5 = the engineer who wrote it

auto_narrative.title: Auto-narrative at milestones
auto_narrative.description: When on, a Stop hook nudges a one-paragraph narrative in the configured mode after milestone turns
